title: Roboratory line.yaml
description: A line model: an intake, the pieces a box passes through, and the pallet it ends on. See docs/FORMATS.md.

schema_version.description: The version of this format, not of the product.

deny.description: Commands no machine of this line may run, added to the sector's and the factory's.

kind.description: Only manual intakes start runs today.

inputs.description: The fields a work order asks for: a name, or a mapping.

pieces.description: The machines, signals and gates, in the order a box meets them unless needs says otherwise.

id.description: The piece's name, unique in the line. It cannot start with @.

goal.description: What this piece is for in this line (at most 250 characters, checked when you save in build mode).

machine.description: The machine folder this piece runs.

signal.description: A script that passes the box on when it exits 0: a command, or { run, timeout }.

gate.description: A place where the box waits for you, or for a rule.

rule.description: Passes the box on by itself when this holds.

choices.description: Options you pick from; the choice is routed on.

confirmations.description: How many times it asks if you are sure.

needs.description: Where the box comes from: a piece id, { from, when, back, laps }, or a list of those.

when.description: A rule over the box; the belt carries it only when this holds.

back.description: A return belt for rework; it needs a when.

laps.description: How many times the box may go back this way.
